records.subject: You're in -- let's get Ridge Group set up
records.body:

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,

draft.subject: Getting Ridge Group's first project going
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for making time for our welcome call last week. I know the first week gets busy, so I wanted to check in on where Ridge Group is with getting started in Wrenfield.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting a first project in place is usually the thing that makes everything else click. When your team is ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through your first project together.

Best,
Chidi
